adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, a new block of code (lines 63-91) performs an unconditional token refresh via fetch() to login.salesforce.com every time a Salesforce connection is created, regardless of whether the existing token is still valid. This is different from other integrations in the diff that use refreshOAuthTokens() which is called conditionally when tokens need refreshing. The finding correctly identifies that this eager refresh adds an unnecessary network dependency - if the Salesforce OAuth endpoint is down, the connection will fail even if the existing access token is still valid. This is a legitimate architectural concern about the implementation approach, though not strictly a bug since the code will work when the endpoint is available.
